_readme: One entry per chapter slot (0-6). Drop slot-0.mp3 / slot-0.ogg etc. next to this file. If a file is missing the captions run on a gentle timer. 'cues' is optional: set it to your real transcript. Each cue: {"t": seconds, "text": "..."} and optionally "words": [{"t": seconds, "w": "word"}, ...] for exact word timing. If cues is omitted, the default script from src/story.js is spread across the audio duration.
